AskPrompt.description: A question the assistant needs answered before it can act; the phone shows it as a card.
AskPrompt.title: AskPrompt

Bookmark.description: A page saved with "Save this page"; tapping it opens it in the current tab.
Bookmark.title: Bookmark

BrowserState.description: Browsing preferences saved on the PC.
BrowserState.title: BrowserState

DeviceRevoke.description: PC -> relay: cut a phone off (live connections are closed, future tokens refused).
DeviceRevoke.title: DeviceRevoke

InputPointerPayload.description: Relative touchpad movement. scroll is in wheel notches, positive = down.
InputPointerPayload.title: InputPointerPayload

LicenseState.description: Shown while the app is not fully licensed (absent = paid, or a PC older than 1.0.0).
LicenseState.title: LicenseState

RoomDelete.description: PC -> relay: forget this room (its phones and records). "Delete my cloud data".
RoomDelete.title: RoomDelete

RoomDeleted.description: Relay -> PC: the room and every phone record of it are gone.
RoomDeleted.title: RoomDeleted

RoomKeyPayload.description: Per-room HS256 key the relay hands to the PC so it can verify device tokens offline.
RoomKeyPayload.title: RoomKeyPayload

StatePatch.description: JSON-merge-patch (RFC 7386) of RoomState; rev must be included.
StatePatch.title: StatePatch

Suggestion.description: A one-tap follow-up offered with a failed result: the phone sends ``text`` as a command.
Suggestion.title: Suggestion

VoiceState.description: This TV's spoken-reply preferences (saved on the PC, so every phone sees the same).
VoiceState.title: VoiceState
